name: Read
description: Read the contents of a file from the local filesystem. Returns the file contents as a string.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to read.

limit.description: Number of lines to read. Optional; defaults to 2000.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed). Optional.

name: Write
description: Write content to a file, creating it if it does not exist or overwriting if it does.

name: Edit
description: Perform an exact-string replacement in an existing file.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to edit.

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences. Optional; defaults to false.

name: Bash
description: Execute a shell command and return its output.

description.description: Short description of what the command does. Optional.

name: Glob
description: Find files matching a glob pattern. Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

path.description: Directory to search in. Optional; defaults to current directory.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files against.

name: Grep
description: Search file contents using a regular expression. Returns matching file paths or content.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files. Optional.

output_mode.description: Output mode: files_with_matches, content, or count. Optional.

path.description: File or directory to search in. Optional.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for.
